definition.simple: Special chemicals sprayed on the farm to kill weeds without hurting the main crop.
definition.academic: Chemical substances used in agriculture specifically designed to destroy or inhibit the growth of weeds without damaging the primary crop.

common_misconceptions: Weedicides kill all plants. (They are specially formulated to target specific weeds while leaving the crop unharmed.)
Weedicides are completely safe. (They can be harmful to farmers and the environment if overused.)
ai_context.tutor_hint: Explain the difference between a weedicide and a pesticide by focusing on what they target.
